texts.content:
Plan Your Visit — Carver Science Museum

Hours: Tuesday–Sunday, 10 A.M.–5 P.M. Closed Mondays. Open until 8 P.M. on the first Friday of each month.

Tickets: Adults $18, children (4–12) $10, children under 4 free. Tickets for the Space Theater show are sold separately and often sell out on weekends, so we recommend buying them online in advance.

Getting here: The museum is a five-minute walk from Union Station. Our small parking lot fills quickly, especially on rainy days.

Food: Our café on the second floor serves light meals. Visitors may also eat their own food in the picnic area outside, but no food is allowed in the exhibit halls.

questions.stem: What is suggested about the Space Theater show?
options: A. It is free for all visitors.
B. It is included in a regular ticket.
C. It is popular on Saturdays and Sundays.
D. It is shown only on the first Friday.
questions.explanation: Theater tickets "often sell out on weekends," which shows the show is popular then.

questions.stem: Why does the museum mention Union Station?
options: A. To warn visitors about traffic
B. To explain where tickets are sold
C. To show where the café is
D. To suggest a way to get there without driving
questions.explanation: It says the museum is "a five-minute walk from Union Station" and that the parking lot "fills quickly," encouraging visitors to use the train.

questions.stem: Where can visitors eat food they bring from home?
questions.explanation: "Visitors may also eat their own food in the picnic area outside."
